title: TrainingDataBinding
description: What a masked-language-model run trains on, the record a run keeps of its corpus, tokenizer and masking policy - a Dataset, a Tokenizer, the sequence length and a MaskingPolicy. Masking is drawn per step from the run seed on stream tag 3 (MaskingPolicy, DESIGN.md § 2.3), never fixed when the corpus is prepared or packed, so the binding holds the policy and no mask. binding_id is the leading 16 bytes, as a version-8 UUID, of the blake3 hash over dataset_id, tokenizer_id, seq_len and the policy's selection_rate, mask_fraction, random_fraction and keep_fraction, in that order, each UUID as its 16 bytes, seq_len as a little-endian u64 and each rate as its little-endian IEEE binary64 bits. `modelspec data pack` writes it as `binding.json` beside its PackedDataset, with BERT's policy; modelspec.training.TrainingRun references it through data_binding_id, which story:bert-train-data-binding writes (coordinator decision D26, 2026-10-24, `.engineering/waves/bert-1.md`).

seq_len.description: The number of tokens of every sequence, S (coordinator decision D26, 2026-10-24, `.engineering/waves/bert-1.md`).

modelspec.data.MaskingPolicy.title: MaskingPolicy
modelspec.data.MaskingPolicy.description: The masked-language-modelling policy; of the selected tokens a fraction is replaced by the vocabulary's mask token, a fraction by a random token and the rest kept, 80/10/10 (epic:bert-from-scratch). The three fractions sum to 1, which ESS does not state here. Draws use the Philox key/counter derivation (DESIGN.md § 2.3) with stream tag 3, the next after the tags 0 to 2 of DESIGN.md § 2.3, keyed by the run seed and drawn anew at every step (coordinator decision D26, 2026-10-24, `.engineering/waves/bert-1.md`). Row n of the batch of step k, flattened to N = B × S rows, takes the block of counter [n, 3, id as u32, (id >> 32) as u32], where id is k for the Train split and k + 2^63 for the HeldOut split. The row is selected when its token is not one of the five special tokens and the uniform draw (w + 0.5) / 2^32 of word 0 is below selection_rate; a selected row becomes `[MASK]` when the uniform draw of word 1 is below mask_fraction, a random token when it is below mask_fraction + random_fraction, and keeps its token otherwise. The random token is 5 + ⌊w2 × (V − 5) / 2^32⌋ for word 2 w2 and vocabulary size V, so it is never a special token. The values are BERT's (Devlin, Chang, Lee, Toutanova 2018, § 3.1) — selection_rate 0.15, mask_fraction 0.8, random_fraction 0.1, keep_fraction 0.1 (coordinator decision D19, 2026-10-24, `.engineering/waves/bert-1.md`).

modelspec.data.SequenceLength.title: SequenceLength
modelspec.data.SequenceLength.description: The number of tokens of every packed sequence, S, at least 1; the type of seq_len on TrainingDataBinding and PackedDataset, so the generated JSON Schema carries the bound as `minimum` 1 (story:content-hash-schema-constrained; coordinator decision D34, 2026-10-25, `.engineering/waves/bert-1.md`).
